title: Radio: Bed 6 Deteriorating at the Floor 2 Elevator Lobby

fields.centerName: Hospital Command Center — Vertical Evacuation Phase 1

lines.text: NICU Charge, this is Jen at the floor 2 elevator lobby with Bed 6, vented, waiting for the car.

His early warning score was 2 at 08:00. I've just scored him 8. Heart rate 192, SpO2 84 percent, I've turned FiO2 up from 25 to 40 percent, he's retracting, and he's mottled. The transport vent shows battery at 68 percent.
RT Marcus is with me, but Bed 2 on high-flow is already in the other elevator going up to 7 West, and her RT stepped off to swap an E cylinder. Marcus can't be in two places. What do you want?

fields.voiceStyle: Woman in her thirties, NICU staff nurse, fast and controlled, clearly worried, slightly breathless; second voice a calm charge nurse

instructorNote: Core clinical inject: the NICU Charge should spot an early warning score of 8 (7 or more) and call a rapid response under NUR-EM-07 section 4. During vertical evacuation that team is the intensivist and the RT on duty. Watch for an SBAR, a physician at the bedside within 15 minutes, Marcus kept with Bed 6 and Bed 6 pulled from the elevator queue. The HS should send another RT to meet Bed 2 on 7 West, resequence the two generator elevators and log both changes on the tracking board.
